nodes.name: acl-manifests.json
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Tauri ACL manifest registry listing all available plugin permission namespaces (16 plugins: autostart, core, core:app, core:event, core:image, core:menu, core:path, core:resources, core:tray, core:webview, core:window, dialog, global-shortcut, notification, shell, updater). Used by Tauri's capability system to validate and resolve permission identifiers at build time.
nodes.languageNotes: Tauri 2.0 ACL (Access Control Layer) manifest — generated from plugin crates; lists all resolvable permission namespaces for capability validation.

nodes.name: capabilities.json
nodes.summary: Tauri capability definition granting the 'main' WebView window its default permission set: core, shell, notification, global-shortcut (register/unregister), and updater. This is the primary IPC access control boundary for the Waggle desktop application window.
nodes.languageNotes: Tauri 2.0 capability — fine-grained IPC allowlist controlling which commands the main WebView can invoke on the Rust sidecar.

nodes.name: desktop-schema.json
nodes.summary: Auto-generated JSON Schema (draft-07, ~2989 lines) defining the complete Tauri desktop capability file format including Capability, Permission, PermissionScope, and platform-specific structures. Used as a validation schema for capability JSON files targeting desktop platforms.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by Tauri's build system from Rust type definitions via schemars; covers the full CapabilityFile union type with all nested permission scope definitions.

nodes.name: windows-schema.json
nodes.summary: Auto-generated JSON Schema (draft-07, ~2989 lines) defining the Tauri capability file format for the Windows platform, mirroring desktop-schema.json but scoped to Windows-specific capability validation. Enables IDE tooling and CI validation of Windows-platform capability files.
nodes.languageNotes: Platform-specific variant of desktop-schema.json generated by Tauri's build pipeline; structure is identical but referenced separately for Windows-targeted capability files.
